groups.reason: A call to action is a button.
A profile photo, image, picture, or headshot of a person is an avatar.
A heading, title, top bar, or masthead is the header.
Find and query are the verb and the field for search.
Price, cost, amount, and money are the same figure.
Dismiss, cancel, and exit are the close control. The letter x is not a synonym; it only counts as the whole ask or beside icon or button.
A blank state is an empty state.
A notice or a warning is an alert.
A toggle and a switch are the same on-off control.
A dialog or a popup is a modal.
A bottom bar is a footer.
A snackbar is a toast.
A separator, divider, and rule are the same hairline.
A pill is a badge.
A coupon, promo, discount, or voucher is the same offer field.
A hyperlink is a link.
Navigation is the full word for nav.
A tick box is a checkbox.
A sidebar item is a nav item.
A table row is a list row.
